title: Single-complex normalization of a target transition
statement: For arbitrary schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a commutative coefficient ring Λ, and étale Λ-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], use the canonical inverse images and composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and the canonical degree-q higher-image triangle transitions [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions]. Let e:Y→T, h:Y→X, π:T′→T, a:Y′→Y, e′:Y′→T′ and h′:Y′→X satisfy a ≫ e=e′ ≫ π and a ≫ h=h′. Let F be a sheaf on T, F′ on T′ and f:π*F→F′. For every integer q, the target transition [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions] followed by the target-functor map of f and the exact single-complex comparison at e′ equals the exact comparison at e followed by the higher-image transition along a and the higher-image map of δ. Here δ:a*e*F→e′*F′ is the inverse (a,e) composition comparison, followed by the (e′,π) comparison transported using a ≫ e=e′ ≫ π, followed by e′*(f).

source.place: Tags 0F07 (lemma-go-down-to-field), coefficient identification preceding condition (2), and 09Z1, canonical restriction maps.

proof.text: The derived triangle transition is natural in its complex: write it as the identity-pullback comparison followed by the derived base-change natural transformation for the degenerate square. Its naturality gives Rh_*(c) followed by the transition at the target of c equal to the transition at its source followed by Rh'_* a*(c). No cartesianness is needed.

Use the already proved upperStarPlusComp_single identity. A generic cancellation lemma gives its forward orientation. Generalize the composite arrow a ≫ e and substitute the square equality to obtain the transported forward orientation for (e',π). Naturality of the e' pullback-single comparison moves the coefficient map f through it. Combine this with the inverse orientation for (a,e). Thus the full derived coefficient composite is a* of the source single comparison, the a single comparison, and the single functor applied to the underived coefficient map δ.

Expand the target transition, target coefficient map, target-functor higher-image comparison, higher-image transition and higher-image map. An abstract categorical normalization lemma combines the two previous identities, using only preservation of composition by derived direct image and homology. Instantiate this proved lemma with the exact category structures and endpoints extracted from the two identities. The existing structural congruence tactic constructs kernel-checked equality conversions to the public expression, avoiding expensive definitional comparison of derived-object expressions.
